resources.string: The bakery is open and everyone wants dessert! Pick the right ingredients from the pantry before your guests run out of patience.

🧁 A guest orders one of 50 Sweet Kitchen desserts.
🧺 Tap the right ingredients in your pantry.
✅ Correct ingredient: +10 points
❌ Wrong ingredient: −5 points and −1 second
🔥 All ingredients in: the dessert goes in the oven and is served
🍰 Dessert served: +50 points + time bonus
👑 VIP guests pay DOUBLE points
🎀 Serve desserts in a row with no mistakes for a combo (x2, x3)
💔 If a guest waits too long, they leave and you lose a heart
⭐ Every 3 desserts the level goes up and guests get less patient
